admission.justification: A preview that answers would-closeout for a leaf the apply refuses sends the orchestrator to ask the developer for a commit approval that cannot be used.

applicability: worktree_closeout_preview, and worktree_closeout_apply as a dry run, for a leaf.
conditions: The preview is called on explicit request; nothing polls it (assumption ASM-NJ9P83).
exclusions: The exact memory-commit tree, which apply judges again after history closing.
No external memory to judge; the gate is not made applicable by this preview contract.
statement: A converted leaf's closeout preview reads the same gate verdict as apply preflight over the same two trees: a refusal shows its findings, asks for no commit approval and offers no apply; a passing preview says the gate passed. Legacy external memory is refused before the preview promises closeout, including a series format verdict before publication authority. Preview publishes no closeout to code, memory or contract; the registered call retains its own daily log and completed-call event.
